scope: Current application source mounted read-only into a one-off development test process; existing PostgreSQL/network reused
command: python -m unittest discover -s /source/tests -v in existing development image
data_policy: Most SQL uses a connection-local TEMP tickets table. One named fictional ticket per run is committed and retained to prove persistence across distinct connections. No existing ticket is removed or changed.
coverage_notes: Real HTTP framework and PostgreSQL, CSRF missing/non-ASCII/wrong session, trusted/untrusted Host
SQL parameterization, constraints, JSON and payload limits, Unicode/NUL rejection, read-after-commit
No database outage injected: only a test double raises a synthetic dependency error
limits: No service redeployed or image rebuilt
No restart, backup, restore, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, CI or physical reception
No user authentication: local fictional-data demonstrator only
